notes.title: Update on April 4th
notes.content: Footsteps sound added. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: The game is now available
notes.content: The game is now available, thank you all for your patience and the hard work of the steam team. Your valuable feedback is welcome.

notes.title: Notice of game delay
notes.content: Since I am not familiar with the process of releasing a game, I have not prepared enough time for the game review, so the game is still under review and I‘m sorry that the date of release will be delayed.
